text: The sympathetic innervation for the viscera involved in this patient's condition originates from the thoracic (T5-T9) and upper lumbar segments of the spinal cord (L1-L2), with specific ganglia such as the celiac, superior mesenteric, and inferior mesenteric ganglia receiving these fibers. The lower gut receives sympathetic supply from the lumbosacral cord, involving fibers from the lower lumbar and upper sacral segments to reach the colon. CONFIDENCE: 85.
